items.name: Default
items.summary: Basic icon button for compact actions and toolbar controls with minimal visual footprint.

items.name: Interactions
items.template:
<nve-icon-button icon-name="menu"></nve-icon-button>
<nve-icon-button interaction="emphasis" icon-name="menu"></nve-icon-button>
<nve-icon-button interaction="destructive" icon-name="menu"></nve-icon-button>
<nve-icon-button disabled icon-name="menu"></nve-icon-button>
items.summary: Icon buttons with different interaction styles including default, emphasis, destructive, and disabled states.

items.name: Size
items.summary: Icon buttons in different sizes (small, medium, large) for varying contexts and visual hierarchy.

items.name: FlatInteractions
items.template:
<nve-icon-button container="flat" icon-name="menu"></nve-icon-button>
<nve-icon-button container="flat" interaction="emphasis" icon-name="menu"></nve-icon-button>
<nve-icon-button container="flat" interaction="destructive" icon-name="menu"></nve-icon-button>
<nve-icon-button container="flat" icon-name="menu" disabled></nve-icon-button>
items.summary: Flat container icon buttons with interaction styles for minimal visual weight in dense toolbars.

items.name: Pressed
items.summary: Icon buttons with pressed state for toggle functionality like filters or visibility controls.

items.name: PressedFlat
items.template:
<nve-icon-button pressed container="flat" icon-name="eye-hidden" aria-label="show"></nve-icon-button>
<nve-icon-button container="flat" icon-name="eye" aria-label="hide"></nve-icon-button>
items.summary: Flat icon buttons with pressed state for low-emphasis toggles and compact toggle controls.

items.name: PressedInline
items.template:
<nve-icon-button pressed container="inline" icon-name="eye-hidden" aria-label="show"></nve-icon-button>
<nve-icon-button container="inline" icon-name="eye" aria-label="hide"></nve-icon-button>
items.summary: Inline icon buttons with pressed state for minimal toggle controls within text or content flows.

items.name: Selected
items.template:
<nve-icon-button selected icon-name="split-vertical" aria-label="split vertical"></nve-icon-button>
<nve-icon-button icon-name="split-horizontal" aria-label="split horizontal"></nve-icon-button>
<nve-icon-button icon-name="split-none" aria-label="preview"></nve-icon-button>
items.summary: Icon buttons with selected state for mutually exclusive options like view modes or layout choices.

items.name: SelectedFlat
items.template:
<nve-icon-button selected container="flat" icon-name="split-vertical" aria-label="split vertical"></nve-icon-button>
<nve-icon-button container="flat" icon-name="split-horizontal" aria-label="split horizontal"></nve-icon-button>
<nve-icon-button container="flat" icon-name="split-none" aria-label="preview"></nve-icon-button>
items.summary: Flat icon buttons with selected state for low-emphasis mode selection in compact toolbars.

items.name: SelectedInline
items.template:
<nve-icon-button selected container="inline" icon-name="split-vertical" aria-label="split vertical"></nve-icon-button>
<nve-icon-button container="inline" icon-name="split-horizontal" aria-label="split horizontal"></nve-icon-button>
<nve-icon-button container="inline" icon-name="split-none" aria-label="preview"></nve-icon-button>
items.summary: Inline icon buttons with selected state for minimal mode selection within content flows.

items.name: CustomIcon
items.summary: Icon buttons with custom content like text initials, emojis, or symbols for personalized actions.

items.name: Link
items.summary: Proper implementation of icon buttons with links, showing correct and incorrect anchor placement patterns.

items.name: Themes
items.summary: Icon buttons styled for light and dark themes with all interaction states for theme consistency.
